purpose.summary: This is a NIST COBOL Compiler Validation System (CCVS) test program (SQ205A) that tests the USE statement with sequential files (mass storage and tape). It creates two sequential files (SQ-FS1 and SQ-FS2) with FILE STATUS clauses, writes records, reads them back, and verifies AT END conditions trigger the USE procedure, reporting pass/fail results.
